csv_project_name: AE for Little Rock Air Force Base C-130J Maintenance
csv_scope_of_work: The Arkansas Department of the Military is soliciting responses from qualified consultants to provide professional architecture and engineering design services as defined by the SAS/Division of Building Authority 22 CAR 111-Minimum Standards and Criteria (MSC) for the construction of anew Consolidated C-130J Maintenance Facility located at Little Rock Air Force Base in Jacksonville, Pulaski County, Arkansas. The project involves demolition of existing facilities, site work, and new construction of a 70,160 SF consolidated Aircraft Maintenance, Fuel System Maintenance and Corrosion Control Maintenance facility for C-130J aircraft,utilizing conventional design andconstruction methods, to accommodate the mission of the facility
